card.name: Start of the word interstitial
card.fires_on: The word piece "Inter" or "inter" that begins "interstitial" in adverse-reaction lists, usually before nephritis, pneumonitis or lung disease. It also fires on other inter- words such as interproximally and intercurrent.

modes.label: Other inter- words
